lcc_original: 對那女人呢，永恆主上帝也說：『我必定增多你懷孕的疼痛【2】；你必在疼痛中生兒女；你必戀慕【3】你丈夫；你丈夫必管轄你。』
notes: 永恆主上帝: LCC makes the subject (יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים) explicit while UNV omits it; no SNs assigned because the provided UNV+SN input does not include them for this verse.
Inf. abs. + finite verb construction (הַרְבָּה אַרְבֶּה, H7235 twice with WTH8687/8686): UNV splits into 多多…加增; LCC merges into 必定增多; both tags attached to 增多 as the single verbal complex.

LCC restructures the pain/bearing clause: Hebrew בְּעֶצֶב תֵּלְדִי בָנִים becomes 在疼痛中生兒女 (in pain bear children) rather than UNV 生產兒女必多受苦楚; tags distributed to maintain Hebrew word order: <WAH09002><WH06089> on 疼痛 (בְּעֶצֶב), <WH03205><WTH8799> on 生, <WH01121> on 兒女.
戀慕 implicit preposition {<WAH0413>}: LCC uses no explicit preposition after 戀慕, so the implicit brace form is preserved.
Footnote markers 【2】 and 【3】 are kept in place after the immediately preceding annotated word.
